items.name: c-date-selector-1
items.title: Basic date selector
items.descriptionLong: Basic date selector. Built by composing Card, Date Selector. Uses date-fns alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn date selector example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-date-selector-1 and edit as your own code.
